sentences.text: The matter has been taken up an office note.

2. It is stated by learned counsel for the petitioners that on 08.11.2023, while quashing the FIR,
inadvertently FIR bearing No. 221/2013 registered at Police Station Shalimar Bagh, North West,
Delhi for offences punishable under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC were mentioned in para No. 13 instead of FIR bearing No. 563/2022 registered at Police Station Madhu Vihar, Delhi for offences punishable under Sections 323/354/354(B)/506/509 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
3. Ordered accordingly.
4. Para No. 13 of order dated 08.11.2023 shall now read as under:-
"13.
